_comment: AE2's four Inscriber presses, added to the sump crate from the pack rather than shipped by the
engine (#46). The presses gate AE2's whole tree: no meteorite falls on this world, and AE2's own
press recipes need a press to make a press.
ADDED, NOT OVERRIDDEN. A pack file at recompile:chests/sump would replace the whole table, echo
shard pool included, and serve a stale copy every time Recompile retuned it. neoforge:add_table
rolls one more table on top of the sump instead, so the pack owns only the pool it cares about.
AIMED by neoforge:loot_table_id. Recompile's docs said that condition never matches its tables;
it does. Measured 2026-09-10 on a dedicated server with this pack: an aimed marker modifier fired
on 10 of 10 sump rolls and 30 of 30 mechanical_pulls rolls, and not on any other table.
WHILE RECOMPILE STILL SHIPS ITS OWN PRESS POOL (pool 2 of chests/sump, through 0.20.0), a sump
yields two sets. Presses are stamps, not ingredients - nothing consumes one - so the second set
is inert. That window closes when Recompile deletes its pool (Flatts3000/recompile#420).
